resources.string: Unofficial client. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Arena.

This is an unofficial client that shows arena.ai in your browser.
Arena\'s FAQ states that prompts in Side-by-Side and Direct modes are collected for research, that those modes do not count as leaderboard votes, and that publicly shared or provider-shared data is de-identified. Your chats are governed by Arena\'s own privacy policy, not by this app.
This app collects nothing. Use test prompts containing no personal data while evaluating it.
